The vocabulary continuous/differentiable/convex must be distinguished by examples. Continuity gives existence via the IVT; strict monotonicity gives uniqueness. For bisection, require an initial interval where the sign changes and a continuous function. A change of convexity, and not merely the vanishing of [[m1]], characterises a point of inflection.
